lap.TTL: Known age >3hours is stale. Unknown age held. Marker age is commit timestamp; run URL is metadata, not heartbeat.
lap.live_same_owner_renewal: Not supported: takeMarker refuses any live marker including sameby/run. No heartbeat/renew flag. --force deliberately overrides live holders and is not ownership-safe heartbeat.
lap.normal_stale_take: After expiry normal CAS take can replace observed stale marker. It does not guarantee continuous protection through expiry.
lap.scope: Only this PR is protected from server lap/merge-ready; no lock on global DEV/other PR merges. Server checks before lap and before push; unreadable lock skipped.
lap.draft: Existing draft excludes this PR from ordinary server lap/merge-ready without needing a long lap lease. Keep draft while long validation runs; any later bounded lap acquisition should be separately verified as held, not inferred from exit0 on remote-unknown fallback.
lap.no_action: No marker acquired, released or renewed.

side_effects: Read-only source inspection, read-only lap --status, budget report only. No browser tests, app edits, gate/rederive, PR writes or dispatches.
